text: Holmes's own part: the telegrams, his waiting, his wire, his judgements
why: The story so far says Holmes received telegrams on Tuesday evening, but it does not mention his waiting, any wire or reply he sent, or his judgements on the case.
Paragraph 12 names Colonel Ross as the owner of the horse who sent a telegram.
Paragraph 12 names Inspector Gregory as the officer looking after the case, who sent a telegram.
Paragraph 12 states that Holmes received telegrams from Colonel Ross and Inspector Gregory.
Paragraph 12 states that on Tuesday evening Holmes received telegrams from both Colonel Ross and Inspector Gregory.
